name: codetutor-mentor
description: An in-editor pair-programming mentor: blueprint, next-step hints, error coaching, and a nudge when you're stuck.

commands.title: CodeTutor: Start a mentored session (set a goal)
CodeTutor: Why is this line here?

codetutor.serviceUrl.description: Base URL of the Python mentor service.

codetutor.idleSeconds.description: Seconds of inactivity before the mentor pitches in when you seem stuck.

codetutor.debounceMs.description: How long to wait after you stop typing before reacting to a completed line.

codetutor.minHintGapMs.description: Minimum time between automatic hints, to avoid flooding you with near-identical advice.

codetutor.enableHoverExplanations.description: Send the current Python buffer for model-generated hover explanations. Disabled by default because hovering is not an explicit disclosure action. Use the 'Why is this line here?' command instead.

codetutor.requestTimeoutMs.description: How long the extension waits for the mentor service (which may be waiting on a slow model) before giving up. Should be larger than the server's model timeout.

codetutor.contextScope.description: How much code to send: the whole file ('buffer') or only the function enclosing your cursor ('function', more private but less context).

codetutor.neverSend.description: Filename glob patterns that are never sent to the mentor service (secrets, keys, credentials).
